page.content:
Aang's traveling family — Katara, Sokka, Toph, Appa, and later Zuko.

How The Gaang connects

  • Series: Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) — The series is the Gaang's journey across the four nations.
  • Character: Aang — Aang is the Avatar the Gaang travels to restore.
  • Character: Katara — Katara is a core member of the Gaang.
  • Character: Sokka — Sokka is a core member of the Gaang.
  • Character: Toph Beifong — Toph joins the Gaang as Aang's earthbending teacher.
  • Character: Appa — Appa carries the Gaang.
  • Character: Azula — Azula hunts the Gaang through the Earth Kingdom.
  • Character: Zuko — Zuko finally joins the Gaang as Aang's firebending teacher.
  • Character: Momo — Momo travels with the Gaang.
  • Location: Southern Water Tribe — The Gaang first gathers at the Southern Water Tribe.

What is The Gaang?

The Gaang is the found family that crosses the map with Aang: waterbenders, a warrior, an earthbending prodigy, a sky bison, and the Fire Nation prince who finally joins.

Key threads lead to Avatar: The Last Airbender (series), Aang, Katara, Sokka, Toph Beifong and Appa.
